answer: Cross-Epoch Delta Consistency (CEDC): each agent submits an epoch action histogram; the protocol computes its delta versus trailing median and counterparty-correlated deltas. Weight is throttled if its delta matches a fresh low-diversity island of accounts or if its value ripple mirrors that island’s transfers. Attacker cost: sybils must maintain divergent multi-epoch histories, diversify counterparties, and accept delayed rewards/throttling, increasing coordination and time cost.
